$comment: Single source of truth for the homepage image system. Read by src/lib/home-images.ts (components), scripts/home-images.ts (placeholders + checks) and ASSET_PROMPT_SHEET.md (prompts). To ship a real image: replace the file at the same path with the final WebP (same aspect ratio) and set "status" to "final" in this file. While "placeholder", components that already had an illustration keep showing it and the alt text stays empty (a tonal plate is decorative). For a picture that a frame crops (object-fit: cover), `sizes` must describe the scaled picture width, not the frame width (see sizesNote).
assetVersionNote: Next's image optimizer caches by URL and has no invalidation: images are requested as <file>?v=<assetVersion> and next.config.ts allows exactly that query string. BUMP THIS NUMBER whenever any file in public/images/homepage is replaced (placeholder -> final, or a new render). v1 = placeholders, v2 = first generated hero + product cards.

spec.decision: 2026-11-06: the founder chose the APPROVED MOCKUPS spec over the creative brief's label / liquid spec, so the homepage matches the 15 finished PDP images. Every bottle in these assets is the approved flacon pixel art composited onto a generated, product-free scene (generators misdraw labels); the generator never draws the bottle.
spec.flacon: 50 ml heavy-base rectangular clear glass, thick solid base; solid cylindrical matte-black grained cap on a polished silver collar
spec.label: straight-edged white matte label: THE RARESKIN® / NAME / ESSENTIALS | 50ml (approved art: design-explorations/packaging-renders/shot0x-<sku>/sources/approved_label_hero.png)
spec.liquid: crystal-clear colourless (founder-frozen; the brief's champagne-to-amber liquid was NOT adopted)
spec.spelling: labels print AUREVAN / ORVÉLIS / VAYRÉN exactly as on the approved art; storefront copy and alt text use the catalogue names AURÉVAN, ORVÉLIS, VAYRÉN
briefDeviations: label text: the brief's 'EXTRAIT DE PARFUM · 50 ML / 1.7 FL. OZ.' is not used (approved mockups)
cap: matte black grained, not a magnetic brushed-gunmetal cap
the brief's '30%+ extrait' is not printed anywhere (the site deliberately states no concentration numbers; see why-extrait.tsx)
note props follow the catalogue (AURÉVAN: citrus, bergamot / white florals / musk, cedar; ORVÉLIS: spices / amber, woods / vanilla, patchouli; VAYRÉN: spices / leather, oud / smoke, amber)
spec.photography: commercial still life, 100 mm macro, f/8-f/11, directional window light with soft diffusion, real materials, no CGI gloss, no HDR halos, no teal-and-orange grade; 5000 K morning (AURÉVAN), 3400 K golden hour (ORVÉLIS), one low amber blade of light (VAYRÉN)

assets.alt: The three THE RARESKIN extraits, AURÉVAN, ORVÉLIS and VAYRÉN, standing side by side on stepped honed travertine pedestals in soft directional light.

The three flacons stand on a low-middle-tall staircase of travertine pedestals spanning x 35-91% of the 16:9 frame, and the left 35% is empty wall (title space for a full-bleed layout). At >=1280px the box shows the part of the frame at object-position 72% 50% (about x 33-87%, which leaves ~50px of wall either side of the outer flacons at 1440x900); wider boxes show more wall at the left. Below 1280px the separate native 4:5 plate is used (three pedestals centred, tops in the central 62% vertically). The picture's focal point comes from this file (CSS custom properties --op-d / --op-m set by hero-media.tsx).
